title: The First Book
author: Alexis of Piemont
full_title: The Secretes of the Reuerende Maister Alexis of Piemount
summary: Medicine: a liquor to preserve youth and hold back old age, potable gold, oils of St John's wort and of scorpions, and remedies for wounds, poisons, worms, the falling sickness, the stone, pleurisy, sciatica, the king's evil and, at length, the plague.
